lines.text: Many learners say: I no have a car.
Better: I don't have a car.
Don't have! I don't have a car.

native.tip: 中文说“没有车”，直接用“没有”否定。英语里要说 “don't have”，不能说 “no have”。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I no have a car.”😅 英语里要说 don't have：“I don't have a car.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I don't have a car.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese uses one word for “not have,” but English says “don't have,” not “no have.”
en.caption: Do you say “I no have a car.” 😅 In English, say “don't have”: “I don't have a car.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
